title: Amma mujhe chupa lo
body:
bazaar mein ye zainab fizza se keh rahi hai
amma mujhe chupa lo
<<DIVIDER>>
bazaar mein ye zainab fizza se keh rahi
abbas ki bahen ko har aankh dhoondti hai
amma mujhe chupa lo
<<DIVIDER>>
dekha na murtaza ne jisko baghair chadar
na-mehramo mein haye wo aagayi khule sar
qatle hussain se bhi dushwaar ye ghadi hai
amma mujhe chupa lo
bazaar mein ye…
<<DIVIDER>>
himmat nahi hai meri kaise khadam badhaun
is shehre be-amaan mein khud ko kahan chupaun
haathon mein leke pathar ummat khadi hui hai
amma mujhe chupa lo
bazaar mein ye…
<<DIVIDER>>
bemaare karbala ke aankhon se khoon hai jari
ye soch kar badan mein larza hai uske taari
beparda shamiyon mein beti batool ki hai
amma mujhe chupa lo
bazaar mein ye…
<<DIVIDER>>
pooche to koi inse cheena hai kya tumhara
pardesi bewatan hai kya jurm hai hamara
kaisa hai ye tamasha ye bheed kyun lagi hai
amma mujhe chupa lo
bazaar mein ye…
<<DIVIDER>>
is naam se hamesha aayi hai mujhko ghairat
paala hai tumne mujhko tum jaanti ho aadat
bazaar zindagi mein zainab kahan gayi hai
amma mujhe chupa lo
bazaar mein ye…
<<DIVIDER>>
saahil pe laashe ghazi us dam tadap gayi thi
sar se chini thi chadar jab binte murtaza ki
wo raat thi andheri ye din ki roshni hai
amma mujhe chupa lo
bazaar mein ye…
<<DIVIDER>>
aaya khayaal jab bhi aansu lagi bahane
bazaar ka takallum kaisa asar tha jaane
aksar watan mein zainab ye kehke chaunk uthi hai
amma mujhe chupa lo
bazaar mein ye…
author: Mir Takallum
